verdicts.reason: Both candidates are essentially the same broken layout. The 'FAMILY DAYS OUT IN' kicker has dropped below and to the left of 'London', so the headline reads out of order. The arrow chevrons are blown up into a huge, overlapping row of six that becomes the main focal point. The translucent panel is gone, so dark text sits directly on a busy, blurry, over-upscaled city photo. B only nudges 'London' and the tagline a few pixels left, which doesn't fix the scattered grouping or the chevron collision.
